CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

   B. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
